rationale: Frozen objective: minimize latency_ms of one timed offline batch-32 FP32 ResNet-18 forward (infer(model, pixels) under torch.inference_mode) on the single leased GPU, bracketed by torch.cuda.synchronize + perf_counter_ns, with exact 1000-class FP32 logits and exact top-1 preserved. The torch collector already ran and its evidence is complete for this unit (coverage.json: 88 CUDA kernels, 100% associated and below project, 0 unassociated, 0 ambiguous forward sequences, 0 backward/autograd ranges), so per-kernel GPU durations and CPU-op-to-kernel attribution are already in hand and torch is not re-requested; nsys is deliberately not selected because no overlap, CUDA-graph tracing or attribution question remains open for the baseline single-stream invocation. The unresolved diagnostic for a short 88-kernel invocation is host-side latency attribution: whether the synchronized wall-clock window is dominated by GPU kernel time or by CPU submit gaps, synchronization waits, and Python dispatch/binding cost through the transformers ResNet stack. execution_timeline is selected for CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization events, per-device busy/idle intervals and clock-alignment bounds within the timed window; python_runtime is selected for a warmed cProfile call trace decomposing host dispatch and wrapper/binding hot paths that the timeline cannot attribute per Python call. Both run the frozen workload unchanged and neither replaces a communication hook or drives search actions. Single-device evidence (observations.json capability field communication=not_applicable 'single-device task'; request.json distributed_backend=null, torch_communication metrics not requested) makes nccl_tuning, collective_calibration and per-collective telemetry inapplicable; device_telemetry is not requested because its device-wide NVML readings with native sampling windows cannot attribute a millisecond-scale invocation and its PCIe/utilization data matches no timed activity (input staging is outside timing; peak_allocated_bytes comes from the torch allocator). candidate_diagnostics and binding_cost are inapplicable before any candidate exists; binding_cost can be selected in later revisions once an additive candidate is built. No PCIe/NVLink traffic is invented from logical payload sizes, and no per-site numerical divergence observation is claimed.
